description.short: Leave and time-off management for SharePoint and Microsoft Teams.
description.full: Brillienta Time Off Manager runs inside SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams and keeps all data in SharePoint lists on your own site. It includes 30 leave types; fixed, accrual, grade-based and tenure-based entitlements with proration and carry-forward; comp off (in lieu) with expiry; full-day, half-day and hourly (two-hour) leave; non-working days and holiday calendars; recurring and bi-weekly leave; leave templates; multilevel approval workflows with delegation, reminders, escalation, auto-approval and approval on behalf of the manager; submitting on behalf of employees; cancellation with approval; a team calendar with Outlook/Teams calendar sync; reports and exports; Power Automate events, a webhook, the REST API and Power BI. Custom theme, brand and logo. Includes a 14-day free trial. Also: editing pending requests, partial first/last days, the sandwich rule, blackout periods, minimum staffing, a My team view for managers, opening-balance import, bulk adjustments, leaving dates, Excel exports, a leave register, Bradford factor and leave liability reports, and an importable Power Automate flow. Microsoft Graph permissions, all optional: User.Read.All (import employees), Calendars.ReadWrite (the person's own calendar), MailboxSettings.ReadWrite (Outlook automatic replies), Group.Read.All and Group.ReadWrite.All (a Teams channel calendar). To use it in Microsoft Teams, a SharePoint admin selects the app in the tenant app catalog and selects Sync to Teams; it then appears in Teams under Apps, Built for your org, as Brillienta Time Off Manager, and finds your Time Off Manager site by itself. Get started: start your free 14-day trial at https://brillienta.com/time-off-manager. Help: read the product guide at https://kb.brillienta.com/time-off-manager/. Contact us: https://brillienta.com/contact or support@brillienta.com.
